title: Workspace suggestion request
description: What the application asks the agent. It carries the request and the slot rules the application owns, so a capacity is never guessed here. Deliberately absent: the entitlement, which the application decides, and anything the agent could read from the catalogue itself.

requestId.description: Correlates every message of one run: the application's log line, the agent's trace and the catalogue endpoint's call line all carry it.

query.description: The customer's own words. Not parsed here, and never returned as copy.

slots.description: The slot rules as the application holds them: the single source of truth for what a slot is called and how many units it accepts.

slot.description: The closed vocabulary a slot set is drawn from. A slot outside it is a schema failure, not a bad suggestion.
